page.content:
Picard's TNG command circle.

How Enterprise-D crew connects

  • Character: Jean-Luc Picard — Picard captains the Enterprise-D crew.
  • Faction: Starfleet — The Enterprise-D crew serves Starfleet.
  • Character: Data — Data is operations officer of the Enterprise-D crew.
  • Character: Worf — Worf is security chief of the Enterprise-D crew.
  • Ship: USS Enterprise — Picard's crew serves aboard later Enterprises.

What is Enterprise-D crew?

The Enterprise-D crew is Picard's next-generation family: Riker, Data, Worf, Crusher, Troi, and La Forge on the Galaxy-class flagship.

Key threads lead to Jean-Luc Picard, Starfleet, Data, Worf and USS Enterprise.
